descriptionHtml:
Lenovo LOQ 15ARP9 Gaming Laptop - AMD Ryzen 5 7235HS - RTX 3050 6GB - Windows 11 Edition

Experience true generational performance transitions with the Lenovo LOQ 15ARP9 gaming platform, proudly offered by Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by the efficient AMD Ryzen 5 7235HS architecture and heavily accelerated by the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB dedicated graphics card, this laptop is engineered to dominate high-frame-rate esports matches. It arrives completely outfitted with pre-installed original Windows 11 Home software to keep your workflows secure and streamlined. Boasting a fluid 15.6-inch FHD display configured with an ultra-responsive 144Hz refresh rate, it delivers tear-free movement while maintaining exceptional contrast thresholds. Built within a reinforced standard Luna Grey chassis, this device is officially backed by a 2-year authorized local agent warranty across Egypt.
